column3: (Content-Type Header Missing - only on 4xx error responses, no body to sniff)
(X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing - set on app responses, missing only on sirv-served static assets, handled at proxy in prod)
(Cookie Poisoning - reflected query param, false positive)
(Non-Storable Content - cache-control noise, not a vulnerability)
(CSP - img-src https: and frame-src wildcards are intentional)
(Permissions Policy Header Not Set - set on app responses, missing only on sirv-served static assets, handled at proxy in prod)
(Session Management Response Identified - informational, not a finding)
(Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens - SvelteKit enforces origin-based CSRF protection on form actions, false positive)
(Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy - require-corp would break cross-origin assets: avatars, fonts, Crisp)
